name: Long Nose Borzoi
subject: a Borzoi (the most-used photos show Lapsha, @loopsnoot)
origin: Viral Borzoi Vines in 2016; the long-nose image macro began on Instagram in October 2020, usually shot with a 0.5× wide-angle lens close to the snout.
attribution: Photos: the @loopsnoot account (Lapsha) and many other Borzoi owners; format by Instagram meme pages.

sources.label: Know Your Meme — Borzoi Long Nose Dog
NBC News — TikTok users are loving borzois

cultural_meaning: An impossibly long, gentle face pushed toward the camera — curiosity, elegance and absurdity at once.

reflection.en: So much nose, coming so close. Maybe that is how you say hello.
reflection.ru: Столько носа, и так близко. Может, так и говорят «привет».
reflection.de: So viel Nase, so nah. Vielleicht sagt man so Hallo.
